kin.name: Sproutle
kin.lore: A walking flower bulb that naps in sunbeams. Scared easily, but plants anything it touches.
kin.personality: Shy, sun-loving, hums when content.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber when gathering.

kin.name: Pebblump
kin.lore: A tortoise whose shell is a pile of river stones. It rearranges them when bored.
kin.personality: Patient, stubborn, loves sunbathing on warm rocks.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Emberkit
kin.lore: A quick fox whose tail is a living flame. It flicks sparks to start campfires for travellers it likes.
kin.personality: Mischievous, loyal once befriended, hates rain.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) and lights the dark.

kin.name: Driplet
kin.lore: A wobbling droplet that gathers morning dew. Its bubble crown pops when startled.
kin.personality: Bouncy, curious about reflections, cries when thirsty.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Voltbeak
kin.lore: A strutting bird that stores static in its zig-zag crest. Rival flocks settle disputes with crackling dances.
kin.personality: Proud, loud, fiercely protective of its nest.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed for you.

kin.name: Frostuft
kin.lore: A shaggy mountain grazer whose wool is so cold snow never melts on it. Herds huddle into drifts during blizzards.
kin.personality: Calm, sleepy, fiercely loyal to its herd.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood (it headbutts trees for you). MOUNT: steady ride that shrugs off blizzards.

kin.name: Barkhorn
kin.lore: A towering stag whose antlers are living branches. Old Barkhorns grow whole thickets on their heads.
kin.personality: Regal, wary, gentle with fawns of any species.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood. MOUNT: fastest ground ride, high jumps. Workers: master logger.

kin.name: Cindermaw
kin.lore: A basalt-plated lizard that swallows hot stones to keep its magma belly glowing. Charges anything that stands on its vent.
kin.personality: Hot-headed, territorial, secretly loves belly rubs.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore and cinder when mining.

kin.name: Glimmoth
kin.lore: A moth with wings of living crystal. On clear nights, swarms refract moonlight into ribbons over the peaks.
kin.personality: Dreamy, drawn to light, startles at loud noises.
kin.perk: Companion: a soft light that follows you at night.

kin.name: Duskit
kin.lore: An imp-cat that only exists where shadows are long. Follows travellers at night, stealing shiny things.
kin.personality: Sneaky, playful, collects anything that glints.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber. Night-worker.

kin.name: Puffpod
kin.lore: A dandelion seed that never landed. It drifts on warm air and plants itself wherever it naps.
kin.personality: Dreamy, weightless, easily blown off course.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Mossnout
kin.lore: A piglet that grows a carpet of moss on its back. It snuffles out truffles and hidden berries.
kin.personality: Greedy, cheerful, loves mud baths.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Brookit
kin.lore: A sleek river otter that carries a favourite pebble everywhere. Brookits build little dams just to splash over them.
kin.personality: Playful, nosy, collects shiny pebbles.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Zapfly
kin.lore: A dragonfly that hums at the same pitch as a thunderstorm. Its wings leave a tingle in the air.
kin.personality: Twitchy, inquisitive, loves shiny puddles.
kin.perk: Companion: a crackling light at night.

kin.name: Thistlehog
kin.lore: A hedgehog whose quills are thistle stems. Crowned with purple blooms in spring, it guards its bramble patch with needle volleys.
kin.personality: Prickly, proud, secretly cuddly.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Lumipup
kin.lore: A puppy born under a meteor shower, still wearing a halo of starlight. It glows brighter when happy.
kin.personality: Adoring, bouncy, afraid of the dark (ironically).
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Bumbleloom
kin.lore: A fuzzy bee that weaves pollen into tiny gardens. Where a Bumbleloom sleeps, flowers bloom by morning.
kin.personality: Busy, polite, hums work songs.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Galewing
kin.lore: A great hawk that rides mountain updrafts all day without flapping once. Its screech can flatten tall grass.
kin.personality: Aloof, sharp-eyed, loyal to one partner for life.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. Camp: expert hauler.

kin.name: Bloomwyrm
kin.lore: An ancient serpent whose scales are petals. Legends say the Great Bloomtree grew from a Bloomwyrm's shed skin.
kin.personality: Serene, ancient, terrifying when its garden is trampled.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries & fiber. Camp: legendary gardener.

kin.name: Ribbloom
kin.lore: A pond frog that wears a lily pad as a sunhat. Its croaks make water plants grow faster.
kin.personality: Laid-back, sings at dusk, hates dry weather.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Burrowby
kin.lore: A near-blind mole with enormous digging claws. It tunnels so fast the ground ripples behind it.
kin.personality: Shy, sleepy, tidy about its tunnels.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Cinderbug
kin.lore: A beetle whose shell stores the day's heat. At night the cracks in its back glow like embers.
kin.personality: Slow, sturdy, loves basking on warm stones.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore and cinder when mining.

kin.name: Dunestrider
kin.lore: A long-legged sand lizard that can cross a whole mesa between sunrise and noon. Caravans of old were built around them.
kin.personality: Patient, hardy, grumbles at wet weather.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. Camp: tireless hauler. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Sparkrat
kin.lore: A desert jerboa that stores static in its long tail. On dry nights you can see Sparkrats as hopping blue sparks.
kin.personality: Hyper, nosy, can't sit still.
kin.perk: Companion: a crackling light at night.

kin.name: Kilnback
kin.lore: An armadillo with chimneys on its back. It rolls into a ball and bakes clay in its own shell.
kin.personality: Grumpy, dependable, snores smoke rings.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Mirageon
kin.lore: A manta that swims through heat shimmer instead of water. Most travellers who see one think it's a mirage.
kin.personality: Elusive, graceful, drawn to bright light.
kin.perk: Companion: soft light at night.

kin.name: Ashcrow
kin.lore: A crow with ember eyes that nests in cooling lava. Flocks follow wildfires to pick through the ash.
kin.personality: Clever, spiteful, remembers faces for years.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore and cinder when mining.

kin.name: Cactoad
kin.lore: A toad disguised as a cactus. It stores a whole rain season's water in its belly and blooms once a year.
kin.personality: Stubborn, patient, blooms when happy.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Rustmaw
kin.lore: A boar with iron-scale hide that roots through ore veins for fun. Its tusks spark when it charges.
kin.personality: Reckless, brave, adores being scratched behind the ears.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore and cinder when mining. Camp: master quarrier. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Solarion
kin.lore: A lion whose mane is a crown of sunlight. Where it roars at dawn, the badlands' cold night breaks instantly.
kin.personality: Majestic, proud, protective of the weak.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura + light. Camp: blazing smelter-master. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Sandsnare
kin.lore: A hooded sand serpent that hunts by moonlight, lying buried with only its violet eyes above the dunes.
kin.personality: Patient, sly, hypnotic stare.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Steamkit
kin.lore: A seal pup born in the badlands' hot springs. It keeps a little geyser under its cap and puffs steam when excited.
kin.personality: Bubbly, clumsy, always warm to hug.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Snowmote
kin.lore: A living snowball with twig arms. Snowmotes roll downhill for fun and come back twice the size.
kin.personality: Giggly, shy, melts a little when embarrassed.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Needlekit
kin.lore: A pinecone sprite that plants a sapling everywhere it sleeps. Whole Rimepine forests trace a Needlekit's wanderings.
kin.personality: Earnest, quiet, smells of resin.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Glaciermane
kin.lore: An ice wolf whose mane is a ridge of living crystal. Packs howl before blizzards - some say they summon them.
kin.personality: Fierce, loyal, runs for the joy of it.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. Fast mount that ignores blizzards. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Hooten
kin.lore: A snowy owl that can spot a glint of ore from the top of a pine. Miners follow Hootens to rich veins.
kin.personality: Watchful, wise-looking, easily distracted by shiny things.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Quartzclaw
kin.lore: A mountain-lake crab that grows its shell from rime crystal. Old Quartzclaws look like walking geodes.
kin.personality: Defensive, stubborn, clacks when happy.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Aurorox
kin.lore: A great musk-ox that carries the northern lights in its mane. Herds migrate along the ridges on the longest nights.
kin.personality: Gentle, immovable, sings in deep hums.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura + light. Camp: legendary hauler. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Yetikin
kin.lore: A young yeti that practises being scary on travellers. It usually ends up carrying their bags instead.
kin.personality: Shy show-off, strong, loves snowball fights.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Staticub
kin.lore: A fluffy mountain pika that builds up static rolling in snow. Petting one is a shocking experience.
kin.personality: Chirpy, friendly, accidentally zaps friends.
kin.perk: Companion: a crackling light at night.

kin.name: Stormcrest
kin.lore: The thunderbird of Rimefang's summit. When it spreads its wings the whole sky darkens, and lightning follows its cry.
kin.personality: Imperious, ancient, respects only the brave.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. Camp: powers a whole base alone.

kin.name: Wispling
kin.lore: A little lantern spirit that guides lost travellers home - if they can keep up. Wisplings vanish at the first light of dawn.
kin.personality: Kind, flickery, easily startled.
kin.perk: Companion: bright lantern light at night.

kin.name: Gloomtoad
kin.lore: A warty toad that only surfaces after dark. Its glowing spots lure moths - and lost travellers - to the water's edge.
kin.personality: Gloomy, philosophical, surprisingly gentle.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Bramblebat
kin.lore: A bat whose wings are woven from thorny leaves. Swarms of Bramblebats strip berry bushes bare in a single night.
kin.personality: Mischievous, hungry, loyal to its roost.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Clayling
kin.lore: A little clay golem that shaped itself from riverbank mud. It copies the gestures of anyone it admires.
kin.personality: Earnest, mimicking, a born apprentice.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Tidalith
kin.lore: A giant turtle carrying a tiny island on its back - complete with a sapling. Birds nest on sleeping Tidaliths for years.
kin.personality: Unhurried, wise, hates being rushed.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Nimbuff
kin.lore: A cloud that decided to become a sheep. When a herd of Nimbuffs gets upset, it drizzles.
kin.personality: Fluffy, anxious, sleeps in the sky.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Bibbit
kin.lore: A ball of fluff with ears twice as long as the rest of it. Bibbits hide by sitting very still and hoping.
kin.personality: Jumpy, soft-hearted, falls asleep mid-hop.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Tuskaroo
kin.lore: A desert bounder with boar tusks and a tail that ends in a spiked knot of bone. It swings first and sizes you up later.
kin.personality: Hot-headed, proud, a surprisingly gentle parent.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Ramparth
kin.lore: A hill-sized ram whose horns grow a new curl every winter. Old herds are said to have carved the mountain passes just by walking them.
kin.personality: Unhurried, immovable, remembers every slight.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood. Camp: tireless hauler. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Lashtail
kin.lore: A ring-tailed trickster that cracks its tail like a whip to knock fruit out of trees - and hats off explorers.
kin.personality: Cheeky, quick-fingered, never where you left it.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Kingmane
kin.lore: A great cat crowned with three horns of old gold. Its roar rolls across the mesas like distant thunder and every lesser kin falls quiet.
kin.personality: Regal, short-tempered, fiercely protective of its pride.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Acornip
kin.lore: An acorn that grew legs instead of roots. It tucks its feet under its cap and pretends to be a nut whenever anything looks at it.
kin.personality: Bashful, tidy, hoards one more seed than it needs.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Vinelash
kin.lore: A snapping pod on a bulb, with two thorned vines it cracks like whips. It is always hungry and not at all picky.
kin.personality: Grabby, gluttonous, sulks when scolded.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Thornback
kin.lore: A walking bramble hill. Birds nest between the thorns on its bark shell, and the bloom on its tail opens only for those it trusts.
kin.personality: Slow to anger, slower to forgive, gentle with small things.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood. Camp: master logger.

kin.name: Floressa
kin.lore: Grown, not born. Her gown is living petals, her slippers are furled leaves and her hair is a waterfall of vines. Gardens bloom where she has walked.
kin.personality: Graceful, curious about people, hums to seedlings.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP. Camp: gifted gardener.

kin.name: Capshroom
kin.lore: A toadstool that wanders at night, trailing a slow halo of glowing spores. Follow one and you will find water - or get very lost.
kin.personality: Sleepy, mysterious, speaks only in yawns.
kin.perk: Companion: soft light at night.

kin.name: Cindling
kin.lore: A fox kit with a candle-flame for a tail. It curls up on cooling lava like a hearth rug and purrs like a kettle.
kin.personality: Nosy, cuddly, sneezes sparks.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Scorchorn
kin.lore: A cliff goat whose horns never cooled. It headbutts boulders to light them, then naps beside the glow.
kin.personality: Stubborn, loud, oddly house-proud about its ledge.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore and cinder when mining.

kin.name: Pyrovern
kin.lore: A wyvern that nests in vents and hunts on the thermals above them. Its wingbeats smell of smoke long before you see it.
kin.personality: Proud, territorial, loyal once its respect is earned.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura + light. Camp: blazing smelter-master.

kin.name: Magmite
kin.lore: A snail that carries a tiny volcano. The shell puffs when it is thinking and rumbles when it is cross - which is rarely, and slowly.
kin.personality: Unbothered, warm, leaves a trail of glass.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Emberhoof
kin.lore: A charger with a mane of living flame. It leaves smoking hoofprints across the mesas and will only carry a rider who can keep up on foot first.
kin.personality: Wild, proud, races the sunset every evening.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. Fast mount with a blazing mane. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Dribblet
kin.lore: A raindrop that decided not to land. It bounces from puddle to puddle blowing bubbles, and cries (more water) when the sun comes out.
kin.personality: Giggly, clingy, terrified of sponges.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Whipsquid
kin.lore: A squid that walked out of the lake to see what all the noise was. Its two long arms snap like wet towels and steal anything shiny.
kin.personality: Inquisitive, slippery, an incurable pickpocket.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Maelstrake
kin.lore: A horned river serpent that stirs whirlpools just to watch them. Fisherfolk used to leave it the first catch of every season.
kin.personality: Imperious, playful in a dangerous way, loves storms.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Puffspine
kin.lore: A puffer that learned to float on air the way it floats on water. Startle one and it doubles in size and bristles from every side.
kin.personality: Nervous, easily offended, secretly loves a tummy rub.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Tidewing
kin.lore: A manta that swims through the sky on sea mist. Whole flights of them cross the island at dusk like slow, silent kites.
kin.personality: Serene, gentle, impossible to hurry.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Chillpip
kin.lore: A penguin chick with an icicle for a cowlick. It toboggans downhill on its belly and waddles all the way back up to do it again.
kin.personality: Fearless, chirpy, follows anyone who looks warm.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Sealance
kin.lore: A plump seal with a single spiral horn of blue ice, longer than its body. It uses it to drill fishing holes and to win arguments.
kin.personality: Jolly, lazy, honks at the moon.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Tundrusk
kin.lore: A woolly giant with tusks of clear ice that never melt. Snow settles on its back and stays there; some carry whole drifts for years.
kin.personality: Ancient, patient, mourns its herd-mates.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood. Tanky mount that ploughs through snow. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Shiverwisp
kin.lore: The breath of a blizzard that never blew away. Shards of ice circle it like tiny moons, and it leaves frost flowers on every window it peeks through.
kin.personality: Lonely, shy, hums like wind in a keyhole.
kin.perk: Companion: soft light at night.

kin.name: Cryodrake
kin.lore: A raptor of the high passes with a crest of living crystal. It hunts by sound, tapping the ice and listening for what moves beneath.
kin.personality: Cunning, relentless, respects only a good chase.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Fuzzap
kin.lore: A lamb so fluffy it is permanently charged. Pet one and your hair stands up for an hour; pet two and you can power a lantern.
kin.personality: Skittish, affectionate, crackles when excited.
kin.perk: Companion: a crackling light at night.

kin.name: Lashvolt
kin.lore: A mud eel with two long feelers that end in glowing bulbs. It dangles them like bait, then cracks them like live wires.
kin.personality: Sly, twitchy, holds a grudge and a charge.
kin.perk: Companion: a crackling light at night.

kin.name: Stormhorn
kin.lore: A plated brute whose horn draws lightning out of a clear sky. The coils along its spine hum for a full day after a storm.
kin.personality: Gruff, dependable, charges first and apologises never.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore and cinder when mining. Armored mount. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Plasmoth
kin.lore: A moth that mistook a thunderhead for the moon and never came back the same. Three motes of ball lightning follow it everywhere.
kin.personality: Dreamy, drawn to lamps, hums in the key of static.
kin.perk: Companion: bright lantern light at night.

kin.name: Raijolt
kin.lore: A storm cat striped with living lightning. You hear the thunder of its paws a heartbeat after it has already passed you.
kin.personality: Restless, competitive, adores a rider with nerve.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. The fastest mount on the island. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Geodeling
kin.lore: A hatchling still wearing its eggshell - except the shell is a geode, and the crack on top is full of amethyst. It rattles when it runs.
kin.personality: Shy, sparkly, hides by sitting among ordinary rocks.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Hornolith
kin.lore: Three ivory horns, a frill of standing stones and a temper to match. It sharpens its horns on canyon walls and leaves spiral grooves a hand deep.
kin.personality: Blunt, sturdy, loyal to its herd above all.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Cragolem
kin.lore: A hillside that stood up. A slow ember burns in its chest, moss keeps one shoulder and crystals the other, and it has never once been in a hurry.
kin.personality: Ponderous, protective, remembers the island before roads.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks. Camp: master quarrier.

kin.name: Scorpite
kin.lore: A scorpion with a stinger of violet crystal. One prick and you are yawning; two and you wake up somewhere else with your pockets lighter.
kin.personality: Patient ambusher, hoards shiny stones, hates boots.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore and cinder when mining.

kin.name: Bouldermaw
kin.lore: What looks like a mossy ridge by the water has teeth. It can lie still for a season, and it closes its jaws faster than a blink.
kin.personality: Still, watchful, strangely tender with its hatchlings.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Zephyrkit
kin.lore: A kitten with wings too small to fly and too proud to admit it. It pounces off anything tall and glides, briefly, in a triumphant spiral.
kin.personality: Daring, purry, lands on its feet about half the time.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Twistail
kin.lore: A seed pod shaped like a spinning top, balanced on one foot under a propeller of leaves. It only falls over when it stops to think.
kin.personality: Dizzy, cheerful, cannot walk in a straight line.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Zephyrion
kin.lore: A sky serpent that swims between the peaks trailing scraps of cloud. Its whiskers taste the weather a full day ahead.
kin.personality: Wise, aloof, fond of riddles it never explains.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. Camp: expert hauler.

kin.name: Windchime
kin.lore: A bell of blown glass that drifts on mountain air trailing silk ribbons. When a dozen gather on a ridge the whole valley can hear them ring.
kin.personality: Peaceful, musical, goes silent when it is sad.
kin.perk: Companion: soft light at night.

kin.name: Galegryph
kin.lore: Lion behind, eagle before, and prouder than both. It bows to no one - but it will kneel, once, for a rider it has chosen.
kin.personality: Noble, exacting, preens for an hour every dawn.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. High-leaping mount. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Inkit
kin.lore: A kitten spilled from an inkwell. All you ever see at night is two lantern eyes - and, in the morning, small black pawprints on everything you own.
kin.personality: Sneaky, playful, pretends it was not following you.
kin.perk: Companion: soft light at night.

kin.name: Hexhorn
kin.lore: A pot-bellied imp with horns too big for its head. It trades in dares, never lies, and never quite tells the truth either.
kin.personality: Mischievous, bargain-loving, cackles at its own jokes.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Duskfang
kin.lore: A hunter cut from the dark between stars, striped with a slow violet glow. It does not chase; it is simply there when you turn around.
kin.personality: Silent, intense, gentle only with the one it trusts.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. Swift, silent mount. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Lanternjaw
kin.lore: A deep-water angler that swims through fog instead. Travellers follow the friendly little light for a long way before they notice the teeth behind it.
kin.personality: Patient, greedy, sulks when the trick does not work.
kin.perk: Companion: bright lantern light at night.

kin.name: Umbrask
kin.lore: A horned shape in a tattered cloak with two pale eyes under the hood and a blade where each hand should be. Wheat fields are found harvested after it passes.
kin.personality: Solemn, exact, keeps every promise it makes.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood. Camp: master logger.

kin.name: Twinklet
kin.lore: A fallen star about the size of a loaf of bread. It hops everywhere, apologises to things it bumps into, and dims when embarrassed.
kin.personality: Polite, wishful, easily flustered.
kin.perk: Companion: soft light at night.

kin.name: Raybit
kin.lore: A hare whose ears grew into two long lamp-stalks. A ring of little lights circles its head, and it is far too pleased with itself about that.
kin.personality: Vain, bouncy, signals friends with ear-flashes.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Lumicorn
kin.lore: A pale charger with a horn of spun light and a mane like dawn mist. Where its hooves touch, the grass keeps a faint glow until morning.
kin.personality: Gentle, wary of strangers, steadfast once befriended.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP. Graceful mount. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Prismite
kin.lore: A crab that grows prisms instead of barnacles. At noon it throws rainbows across the whole canyon floor and clacks happily at each one.
kin.personality: Fussy, house-proud, polishes itself on sandstone.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Halcyrie
kin.lore: The dawn bird. It crosses the island once each morning with a halo over its crest and three ribbons of light behind it, and the day does not start until it has.
kin.personality: Radiant, unhurried, answers kindness and nothing else.
kin.perk: Companion: bright lantern light at night. Camp: powers a whole base alone.

kin.name: Knuckub
kin.lore: A bear cub that wraps its paws in woven reed and spars with anything that moves. It never backs down from a friend's fight.
kin.personality: Brave, hot-headed, fiercely loyal.
kin.perk: Vanguard: +15% melee damage for you. Hits 20% harder on the kin you're fighting.

kin.name: Chiskit
kin.lore: A tidy little beaver who wears a scrap-bark hard hat. It cannot see a loose log without stacking it into something useful.
kin.personality: Industrious, particular, hums while it works.
kin.perk: Prospector: +35% yield from every tree, rock and plant. Camp: master logger & crafter.

kin.name: Hopling
kin.lore: A long-eared hare whose scarf always streams as if in a breeze. Travellers say a Hopling can outrun a storm - and bring you home through it.
kin.personality: Cheerful, restless, protective of the weary.
kin.perk: Tailwind: +15% speed, -35% stamina use, and an emergency heal when you drop low. Dazzle Hop makes kin drowsy (easier captures).

kin.name: Cocorab
kin.lore: A beach crab that never found a shell, so it moved into a coconut. It rolls downhill inside it when frightened.
kin.personality: Skittish, house-proud, pinches first.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Shellby
kin.lore: A turtle hatchling that paddles the lagoon in little convoys. Each one decorates its shell with whatever washes up.
kin.personality: Patient, trusting, collects sea glass.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Starlet
kin.lore: A sea star that cartwheels along the tideline at dusk, glowing faintly. Sailors once steered by whole beaches of them.
kin.personality: Cheerful, show-off, sticks to everything.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Gullwing
kin.lore: A noisy white seabird that follows anything carrying food. A flock can strip a picnic in the time it takes to shout.
kin.personality: Loud, greedy, loyal to whoever fed it last.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Palmunk
kin.lore: A striped island squirrel whose tail has grown into a palm frond. It naps underneath it at noon.
kin.personality: Nosy, quick, hoards coconuts it can't open.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Bubblefin
kin.lore: A round reef fish that swims through the sea air inside a film of water, trailing a ring of bubbles it refuses to let pop.
kin.personality: Dreamy, gentle, counts its bubbles.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Coralope
kin.lore: A slender antelope that wades the shallows at low tide. Its antlers are living coral, and small fish follow it between islets.
kin.personality: Graceful, wary, never far from water.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Seastride
kin.lore: An upright sea-horse that bobs just above the waves, anchoring its tail round driftwood to sleep.
kin.personality: Polite, old-fashioned, easily seasick on land.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Parrokeet
kin.lore: A gaudy island parrot that repeats the last thing it heard, usually at the worst moment. Its tail feathers are prized and it knows it.
kin.personality: Vain, talkative, a terrible secret-keeper.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Clampearl
kin.lore: A clam whose pearl grew eyes and opinions. The shell snaps shut on anything rude, and stays shut until apologised to.
kin.personality: Prim, sulky, shines when praised.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Jellume
kin.lore: A lantern jellyfish that drifts inland on warm nights. Islanders hang their washing out by its light.
kin.personality: Placid, forgetful, hums off-key.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Krakling
kin.lore: The bad-tempered young of something much larger that lives past the reef. It practises sinking toy boats.
kin.personality: Grumpy, ambitious, holds grudges with all eight arms.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Tortide
kin.lore: A sea turtle old enough that a palm has taken root on its shell. It ferries smaller kin between the Driftkeys and has never once hurried.
kin.personality: Ancient, kindly, tells very long stories.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Wavecrest
kin.lore: A dolphin that leaps so high it stopped coming down. It races boats for fun and lets the slow ones win now and then.
kin.personality: Playful, clever, loves an audience.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Reefwarden
kin.lore: A walking piece of the reef itself, crowned in coral and studded with pearls. It rises when the Driftkeys are threatened and sinks back when they are not.
kin.personality: Slow to anger, impossible to stop, gentle with hatchlings.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Mudpup
kin.lore: A marsh puppy that has never once been clean. It greets everyone by shaking itself dry beside them.
kin.personality: Joyful, sloppy, fetches things nobody threw.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Tadpoll
kin.lore: All head, all tail, and two feet it hasn't worked out yet. Shoals of them wriggle across the mudflats after rain.
kin.personality: Wide-eyed, wobbly, follows the crowd.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Skeeter
kin.lore: A mosquito the size of a cat with a needle to match. You hear the whine long before you find out where it is.
kin.personality: Persistent, shameless, loves ankles.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Lotuskip
kin.lore: A pond frog with a lotus rooted on its back. The flower opens when the frog is happy, so everyone always knows.
kin.personality: Calm, honest, a little smug about the flower.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Fenfly
kin.lore: A marsh firefly with a lantern for a tail. Travellers who follow one usually end up somewhere dry. Usually.
kin.personality: Shy, flickery, blinks when nervous.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Bogsnap
kin.lore: A flytrap that pulled up its roots to go and find lunch. It holds perfectly still among the reeds with its mouth open, and it is very patient.
kin.personality: Hungry, sneaky, snaps at shadows.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Reedstalk
kin.lore: A grey heron on stilt legs that stands so still the reeds grow round it. It moves exactly once, and by then the fish is gone.
kin.personality: Aloof, precise, judges your posture.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Leechlash
kin.lore: A fat marsh leech with two feelers it cracks like whips. It doesn't want much. Just a little. Just a taste.
kin.personality: Clingy, wheedling, never lets go first.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Rushcat
kin.lore: A marsh cat with reeds growing along its spine and a cattail for a tail. It hunts by pretending to be scenery.
kin.personality: Sly, playful, pounces on anything that wobbles.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Murkfin
kin.lore: A catfish that got tired of its pond drying up and grew legs out of spite. Its whiskers taste the mud for miles around.
kin.personality: Gruff, stubborn, a secret softie.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Sporetoad
kin.lore: A heavy toad that sits so long in one spot that toadstools grow on it. Squeeze one and the whole clearing goes quiet and sleepy.
kin.personality: Drowsy, unbothered, burps spores.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Mirejaw
kin.lore: The log that isn't a log. A Mirejaw can lie in the channel for a week with only its eyes showing, and cross the whole fen in one lunge.
kin.personality: Cold, patient, oddly fond of its rider.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Fenlight
kin.lore: A marsh-light in a ragged little cloak. It leads the lost out of the fen, or further in, depending on how polite they were.
kin.personality: Mischievous, fair-minded, loves riddles.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Mangrowl
kin.lore: A bear-shaped tangle of mangrove with a whole thicket on its back. Herons nest in it. It has opinions about people who snap branches.
kin.personality: Protective, rumbling, slow to forgive.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Hydrabog
kin.lore: Three heads, one stomach, no agreement. The Mirefen's oldest terror spends most of its time arguing with itself, and the fen is safer for it.
kin.personality: Quarrelsome, cunning, each head sulks separately.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Fennick
kin.lore: A pocket-sized dune fox with ears big enough to hear a beetle sneeze. It sheds the day's heat through them and sleeps till dusk.
kin.personality: Alert, skittish, snuggles for warmth at night.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Scarabit
kin.lore: A jewel-backed beetle that rolls a ball of sand everywhere it goes. Nobody knows where it is taking it. Neither does the beetle.
kin.personality: Diligent, single-minded, polishes its shell.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Tumblit
kin.lore: A tumbleweed with a pair of eyes somewhere in the middle. It goes wherever the wind is going and calls that a plan.
kin.personality: Carefree, scatterbrained, impossible to offend.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Meerkit
kin.lore: A sentry by nature. One Meerkit always stands watch on the dune crest while the rest dig, and they all swap when it whistles.
kin.personality: Watchful, bossy, takes turns very seriously.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Dunelet
kin.lore: A handful of sand that the wind taught to walk. It leaves a tiny dune wherever it naps and is always sorry about your boots.
kin.personality: Mild, apologetic, gets everywhere.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Rattlecoil
kin.lore: A diamond-backed viper that gives exactly one warning, and it is the rattle. Old caravan songs are mostly about not ignoring it.
kin.personality: Tense, proud, fair about warnings.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Frillizard
kin.lore: A lizard that settles every argument by snapping its frill open like a sunrise. It has never needed a second argument.
kin.personality: Dramatic, hot-tempered, all bluff until it isn't.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Vulturn
kin.lore: A bald-headed circler that can wait longer than you can walk. Seeing one overhead is not bad luck. Seeing three is.
kin.personality: Morbid, patient, surprisingly tidy.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Prickpear
kin.lore: A cactus that wants a hug more than anything in the world. It carries its fruit around to share and waves with both pads.
kin.personality: Affectionate, lonely, painfully friendly.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Dromble
kin.lore: A two-humped plodder that carries half a caravan and complains the whole way. It can cross the Sunscour without a drink and will never let you forget it.
kin.personality: Grumbly, dependable, spits when ignored.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Sandjackal
kin.lore: A lean black jackal with a gold collar nobody remembers giving it. It guards old tombs out of habit and hunts trespassers out of interest.
kin.personality: Solemn, loyal, never blinks first.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Sunsphinx
kin.lore: A winged lion in a striped headdress that asks every traveller a riddle. It has forgotten the answers and accepts anything said with confidence.
kin.personality: Regal, vain, secretly bored.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Sandwyrm
kin.lore: The dunes move because something is moving under them. A Sandwyrm surfaces mouth-first, and its mouth is most of it.
kin.personality: Ravenous, simple, follows footsteps.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Wrapscal
kin.lore: Nobody has ever seen what is under the bandages, and it unwinds a little more every year. It collects shiny things in case one of them is its own.
kin.personality: Light-fingered, giggly, afraid of loose threads.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Djinnado
kin.lore: A spirit of the hot wind, horned and gold-braced, riding the whirlwind it is made of. It grants exactly no wishes and finds the question hilarious.
kin.personality: Booming, theatrical, respects a good bargain.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Oozlet
kin.lore: A blob of something from the bottom of a blight pool that woke up friendly. It leaves a glowing trail and means no harm by it.
kin.personality: Sweet, sticky, doesn't know it's toxic.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Blightrat
kin.lore: A mangy scavenger that eats what even the moor won't. It travels in packs and the packs travel towards your food.
kin.personality: Bold, greedy, strangely house-proud.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Sporeling
kin.lore: A toadstool toddler under a cap three sizes too big. When scared it sits down, and from above it is just another mushroom.
kin.personality: Bashful, clumsy, hides in plain sight.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Stingnat
kin.lore: A striped moor-wasp with a temper and a barb to back it up. A swarm sounds like a kettle about to boil.
kin.personality: Irritable, territorial, holds a grudge for one day exactly.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Rotgrub
kin.lore: A fat pale grub that chews through dead wood and dreams of being something with wings. It has been dreaming a very long time.
kin.personality: Hopeful, slow, eats when anxious.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Venomoth
kin.lore: A great soft moth whose wings stare back at you. The dust it sheds is a slow poison, which it finds very embarrassing.
kin.personality: Gentle, drawn to lanterns, apologises with its whole body.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Acidrake
kin.lore: A wiry little drake that spits something that smokes on stone. It can't fly on those wings and takes it out on everyone.
kin.personality: Snappish, cocky, has a lot to prove.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Silkspin
kin.lore: A moor spider that weaves in patterns, never the same twice. Its webs are stronger than rope and it charges for them in bugs.
kin.personality: Fussy, artistic, hates being watched while it works.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Fumeskull
kin.lore: The skull of something horned, drifting on the fumes that leak out of it. It chatters its teeth at travellers and cackles at its own jokes.
kin.personality: Rude, cackling, lonely underneath.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Blightbloom
kin.lore: An enormous red flower on two stubby legs. It smells like the worst day of your life and has no idea why it has so few friends.
kin.personality: Warm-hearted, oblivious, a hugger.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Rustcrawler
kin.lore: A plated crawler that eats metal and wears the rust. Miners used to follow them to ore, then run from them with it.
kin.personality: Dour, methodical, clanks when it's happy.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Rothound
kin.lore: A gaunt hound with its ribs on the outside, tireless and never quite alive. It runs down anything on the moor, then waits to be told what to do with it.
kin.personality: Relentless, obedient, starved for praise.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Miasmare
kin.lore: A dark horse with a mane of drifting green fog. Where it gallops the mist follows, and whole valleys have vanished behind it.
kin.personality: Wild, haughty, gentles for exactly one rider.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Sludgeback
kin.lore: A wallowing giant that carries its own blight pool in a hollow on its back. Small kin bathe in it. Nobody else should.
kin.personality: Easygoing, yawny, moves for no one.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Venomarch
kin.lore: The crowned serpent of the Blightmoor. Every pool on the moor is said to have dripped from its fangs, and it counts them all as its own.
kin.personality: Imperious, jealous, never forgets a debt.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Glowmite
kin.lore: A bead of light with feet. Glowmites gather wherever something is growing, and the Glowdeep's paths are mostly just where they sit.
kin.personality: Tiny, trusting, dims when sad.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Neonewt
kin.lore: A cave newt striped in living neon with frilly pink gills. It smiles at everything, which is unsettling in the dark.
kin.personality: Cheery, nosy, grins through anything.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Capglow
kin.lore: A tall-capped mushroom that lights its own way and everyone else's. Rows of them line the Glowdeep like street lamps that wander off.
kin.personality: Helpful, sleepy, hums to keep its light steady.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Pixiwing
kin.lore: A finger-high sprite with four wings of light. It steals single buttons, never the pair, and nobody has found where they go.
kin.personality: Flighty, teasing, bursts into giggles.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Glimworm
kin.lore: A chubby glow-worm that lights up one band at a time, like a very slow sentence. Others answer from across the dark.
kin.personality: Thoughtful, quiet, talks in blinks.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Prismfox
kin.lore: A pale fox with three tails, each tipped in crystal. When it runs, the light it throws paints the whole grove in rainbows.
kin.personality: Quick-witted, elusive, loves to be chased.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Noctowlet
kin.lore: A round little owl whose eyes glow like twin moons. It sees perfectly in the dark and stares at you to prove it.
kin.personality: Wise-looking, actually clueless, loves a head scratch.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Bulbfrog
kin.lore: A frog with a lantern for a throat and a little lure bobbing over its head. It croaks in flashes, and the pond flashes back.
kin.personality: Mellow, musical, a patient listener.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Shardillo
kin.lore: An armadillo that grows crystals instead of armor. Curled up it is a geode, and more than one miner has taken a pick to the wrong rock.
kin.personality: Prickly, cautious, warms up slowly.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Sporeglide
kin.lore: A seed with a face, hanging under a parasol of glowing threads. It drifts wherever the air is warm and plants itself for a nap.
kin.personality: Airy, wistful, never in a hurry.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Lunelk
kin.lore: A silver elk whose antlers curve into a crescent moon. It walks the Glowdeep in silence, and the lights dim as it passes, out of respect.
kin.personality: Serene, dignified, chooses its rider carefully.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Glowmaw
kin.lore: The friendliest light in the Glowdeep hangs in front of the biggest mouth. A Glowmaw waits in the dark behind its lure and has never had to chase anything.
kin.personality: Lazy, cunning, smiles too much.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Myceliath
kin.lore: A mushroom the size of a house that stood up one day. Every glowing thing in the Glowdeep is said to be threaded back to it underground.
kin.personality: Deliberate, ancient, speaks once a decade.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Starwhal
kin.lore: A sky-swimming whale with a star on the end of its horn. It sings the Glowdeep to sleep, and the mushrooms sway in time.
kin.personality: Gentle, dreamy, hums through everything.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Astralisk
kin.lore: A serpent of night sky, winged, crystal-spined and haloed in slow-turning stars. The Glowdeep glows because it once slept there, and it has come back to check.
kin.personality: Remote, curious, weighs every word.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Krakolos
kin.lore: The Kraken. It sleeps under a lone rock in the south-east sea with a wrecked fleet for a nest, and Kraklings are what it leaves behind.
kin.personality: Vast, patient, takes everything personally.

kin.name: Marelune
kin.lore: The moon-tide. Islanders say the lagoon rises and falls because Marelune breathes, and that it carries the drowned moon on its brow so the sea is never dark.
kin.personality: Vast, gentle, older than the reef.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Oldroot
kin.lore: The first tree of the Mirefen, which got tired of standing. Its antlers are two whole canopies hung with lantern fruit, and the fen grows wherever it has walked.
kin.personality: Slow, watchful, forgives nothing done to the fen.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Solphyre
kin.lore: The sun-bird of the Sunscour. It burns down to a single ember every dusk and is whole again by dawn, and the dunes are said to be the ash of all its yesterdays.
kin.personality: Radiant, proud, impossible to look at for long.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Noxaris
kin.lore: The plague-wing. Where Noxaris sleeps the ground goes soft and green, and the Blightmoor is simply the shape of its bed.
kin.personality: Brooding, territorial, lonelier than it lets on.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Kiralux
kin.lore: The star-kirin. It runs the Glowdeep once each night and every mushroom it passes lights up behind it. Nothing has ever kept pace.
kin.personality: Fleet, shy, drawn to quiet people.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed. MOUNT: rideable with a Kin Harness.

kin.name: Wickit
kin.lore: A soft, waxy little kin with a flame that never goes out on its head. Meadow folk used to coax one home at dusk instead of lighting a lamp.
kin.personality: Sleepy, trusting, afraid of puddles.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Hearthog
kin.lore: A hedgehog whose quills are slow-burning coals. It banks them low to sleep and fans them bright when startled; farmers bake potatoes beside a drowsy one.
kin.personality: Grumpy when woken, generous with warmth.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Flickadee
kin.lore: A finch with a crest and tail of real flame. Flocks follow grass fires across the meadow, snapping up whatever runs from them - and now and then they start one.
kin.personality: Cheeky, restless, sings at sparks.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Kagekit
kin.lore: A cat that walks upright and is never where you last saw it. Kagekit train alone on rooftops and treetops, and settle every quarrel with a single strike from behind.
kin.personality: Silent, proud, keeps score.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Raikunai
kin.lore: A lean black weasel that moves between heartbeats. The scarf round its neck is a live strip of lightning, and the blade at the end of its tail was never forged by anyone.
kin.personality: Restless, sharp-tongued, hates waiting.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Kasamantis
kin.lore: A wandering mantis that never lifts the brim of its reed hat. It stands so still that birds land on it, and it has never needed a second cut.
kin.personality: Patient, courteous, utterly merciless.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Kabutaro
kin.lore: A rhinoceros beetle whose shell grew into lacquered plates. It can stand in a mountain pass for a day without moving; travellers who took it for a statue did not get a second look.
kin.personality: Stern, ceremonious, bows before a fight.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Bulwarden
kin.lore: Nobody has seen what is inside the armour. A Bulwarden picks someone smaller than its shield and stands in front of them for the rest of its life.
kin.personality: Earnest, stubborn, takes oaths very seriously.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% stone and ore from rocks.

kin.name: Jabaroo
kin.lore: It bounces on its toes even when asleep. Jabaroo settle everything in three punches, shake hands afterwards, and remember every bout they have lost.
kin.personality: Cocky, fair, never hits first.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Rapieron
kin.lore: A heron that fences with its own beak. It waits on one leg in the shallows for a challenger to make the first move, because the first move is always a mistake.
kin.personality: Vain, gallant, insufferable when it wins.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Hexpurr
kin.lore: A cat that found a hat, then a broom, then worked out the rest by itself. Its curses are small and petty - until something else hits you while one is on you.
kin.personality: Smug, nosy, purrs at misfortune.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Prestofox
kin.lore: It bows, the lights flare, and the fox you are looking at is no longer the fox. Prestofox never explain a trick and never do the same one twice in a town.
kin.personality: A show-off, generous with applause, hates hecklers.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Marionoir
kin.lore: It carries a doll stitched in its own likeness and makes it dance for anything that comes close. By the time the audience notices the threads, they are already tied.
kin.personality: Patient, theatrical, talks through the doll.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Morbeak
kin.lore: A crow in a bone mask that walks the Blightmoor with a satchel of vials. One colour mends and one colour rots, and it has never told anyone which is which.
kin.personality: Solemn, meticulous, bedside manner of a headstone.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Lilute
kin.lore: A frog with a lute it grew from a lily pad. When a Lilute plays at the edge of a pond the whole bank works faster, and nobody remembers deciding to.
kin.personality: Easygoing, vain about its voice, never off-key.
kin.perk: Companion: lights up the night around you.

kin.name: Encorine
kin.lore: It dances whether or not anyone is watching, but it knows when someone is. An Encorine never ends on its best number - it does that one again.
kin.personality: Radiant, tireless, lives for the second bow.
kin.perk: Companion: +12% run speed.

kin.name: Flambear
kin.lore: A bear that learned to cook over the Badlands vents and never looked back. It will feed anyone who sits down politely, and set fire to anyone who touches the pan.
kin.personality: Warm, loud, deadly serious about seasoning.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light. Camp: the best cook there is.

kin.name: Forgemole
kin.lore: It digs to where the rock is still warm and sets up shop. The anvil on its back is never cold, and anything a Forgemole has struck once holds an edge for good.
kin.personality: Gruff, short-sighted, proud of honest work.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining. Camp: born for the forge.

kin.name: Mortamoth
kin.lore: A moth that drifts down out of the snow in a hood of its own wings. It only comes for the weak and the wounded, and it is never in a hurry.
kin.personality: Quiet, gentle with the dying, unsettlingly polite.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% wood.

kin.name: Vespertine
kin.lore: It wears its wings as a cloak and expects to be announced. A Vespertine takes only a little from each guest, which is how it has lived long enough to have this many manners.
kin.personality: Courtly, thirsty, offended by garlic.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Armadraw
kin.lore: It stands in the road at noon with its hat pulled low and a spark sitting ready in its paw. Nobody has ever seen an Armadraw fire second.
kin.personality: Laconic, squints at everything, a soft touch underneath.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% ore, cinder and crystal when mining.

kin.name: Cutlotter
kin.lore: An otter with an eyepatch it does not need and a hook it does. Whatever a Cutlotter hits loses something, and the otter is usually wearing it by evening.
kin.personality: Cheerful, light-fingered, loyal to a fault.
kin.perk: Companion: +50% berries and fiber.

kin.name: Sirelle
kin.lore: She swims through the air as easily as the lagoon, trailing her hair like weed in a current. Sailors of the Driftkeys say her song pulls boats onto the reef, and that nobody on board minded.
kin.personality: Playful, flirtatious, collects shiny things from wrecks.
kin.perk: Companion: slowly restores your HP.

kin.name: Sekhara
kin.lore: The dunes remember a queen with a lioness's head who carried the evening sun on her brow. She walks them still, tall and unhurried, and what her shadow falls on at dusk does not see morning.
kin.personality: Regal, exacting, merciless to the disrespectful.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

kin.name: Cindra
kin.lore: A hound that walks on two legs, with hair and tail of open flame. She chooses one person and keeps to their heel for good; when she throws back her head and howls, everyone on her side stands a little taller.
kin.personality: Bold, teasing, fiercely loyal.
kin.perk: Companion: warmth aura (slower hunger) + light.

structures.name: Alloy Forge
structures.about: Smelts the outer lands' ores into bars (and Rustore into Ingots, faster than a Smelter). Kindling kin work it.

structures.name: Crop Plot
structures.about: Grows Sunberries, or any crop you plant (CROP in Camp > Structures), a batch at a time: Cultivating kin plant it, Irrigating kin water it (a farmer can, slowly), it grows by itself, then Cultivating or Foraging kin harvest.

structures.name: Bulk Silo
structures.about: +60 base storage slots in one tall tower.

structures.name: Campfire
structures.about: Cooking station. Kindling kin keep the fire going.

structures.name: Feed Box
structures.about: Camp kin eat from this box. Six slots of its own for kin food (tap FEED BOX); it keeps itself stocked from camp storage unless you switch that off.

structures.name: Forage Hut
structures.about: Foraging kin bring in a batch of Fiber (and the odd berry), then it sorts and dries by itself.

structures.name: Grand Vault
structures.about: +180 camp storage slots: a stone treasury with a crystal lantern. The last storage a camp needs.

structures.name: Greenhouse
structures.about: A glass-roofed plot that plants, waters and harvests itself, kin or no kin. Cultivating and Irrigating kin make it faster. Tap CROP in Camp > Structures to choose what it grows.

structures.name: Hearthstone
structures.about: The heart of your camp. Claims land, stores kin and items. Only one.

structures.name: Ironbound Vault
structures.about: +100 camp storage slots behind an iron door.

structures.name: Kin Clinic
structures.about: Fainted kin resting in camp recover three times sooner and wake at 60% health. Resting kin heal twice as fast.

structures.name: Kin Nest
structures.about: Beds for 2 workers, who sleep here from dusk to dawn. With a bed for every worker the camp works 15% faster.

structures.name: Large Chest
structures.about: +40 camp storage slots: twice a Storage Chest, in a banded trunk.

structures.name: Lumber Mill
structures.about: Logging kin saw a batch of Wood, then it seasons by itself while they do something else.

structures.name: Stone Quarry
structures.about: Quarrying kin set the wedges, then the Stone splits by itself while they do something else.

structures.name: Storage Chest
structures.about: +20 storage slots with contents of their own: tap OPEN to put things in or take them out. Haulers deliver here.

structures.name: Training Yard
structures.about: Camp kin earn work XP twice as fast while it stands.

structures.name: Volt Turret
structures.about: While a Volt Pylon is running, shocks any raider or hostile kin that comes near (about 20 m).

structures.name: Waypad
structures.about: Links your outposts to the waystones: every outpost becomes a fast-travel destination (Map tab).

structures.name: Workbench
structures.about: Crafting station. Queued orders are worked by Crafting kin (and you, if nearby).

structures.name: Hatchery
structures.about: Pair two kin to get an egg that inherits the best of both (Camp > Hatchery).

structures.name: Research Bench
structures.about: Study blueprints here: new metals, machines and outposts. A Crafting kin does the work (or you, standing at it).

structures.name: Smelter
structures.about: Kindling kin stoke it with 4 Rustore from camp storage, then it smelts 2 Ingots by itself.

structures.name: Fishing Pond
structures.about: A stocked pool with a little jetty. Kin with the Fishing job (Tide kin, and kin that live by water) pull Silverfin from it - food for the camp, or for your own fire.

structures.name: Frost Larder
structures.about: Keeps food fresh: workers get hungry 40% slower while it holds cold. A Chilling kin fills it with cold, then is free for other work and comes back to top it up at half and before nightfall. One larder stays cold all night.

structures.name: Spark Dynamo
structures.about: Charging kin power it: +25% production for the whole base.

structures.name: Deep Drill
structures.about: Quarrying kin wind the drill, then it bores Rustore out of deep rock by itself.

structures.name: Sprinkler
structures.about: Waters every Crop Plot by itself and makes farms (Crop Plot, Forage Hut) work 40% faster while it runs: camp power or an Irrigating kin.

structures.name: Conveyor Hub
structures.about: Powered: moves every producer's output into storage (no haulers needed).

structures.name: Volt Battery
structures.about: Stores charge from a Volt Pylon, so the camp's machines keep running while its kin sleeps. Each one holds about a third of a day: a pylon and one battery, filled by day, last the night.

structures.name: Volt Pylon
structures.about: Powers the whole camp (Conveyor Hub, Auto-Assembler, Sprinklers, Turrets). A Charging kin fills it like a battery, then is free for other work and comes back to top it up at half charge and before nightfall. Holds a fifth of a day; build Volt Batteries to store more.

structures.name: Auto-Assembler
structures.about: Powered: works queued Workbench and Campfire orders on its own.

research.name: Alloy Forging
research.about: A hotter furnace for metals the Smelter can't melt. Every outer-land metal starts here.

research.name: Joinery
research.about: Banded trunks: a Large Chest holds twice what a Storage Chest does.

research.name: Bulk Storage
research.about: A tall silo that holds as much as three chests.

research.name: Ironbound Vaults
research.about: An iron-doored vault that holds as much as five chests.

research.name: Grand Vault
research.about: A stone treasury: nine chests' worth under one roof.

research.name: Kin Medicine
research.about: A clinic where fainted kin are back on their feet three times sooner.

research.name: Training Methods
research.about: A yard where camp kin learn from their work twice as fast.

research.name: Volt Defenses
research.about: Turrets that shock raiders while a Volt Pylon is running.

research.name: Outpost Logistics
research.about: Outpost Kits: found a small camp on an outer land, station kin there, and a caravan brings what they gather home.

research.name: Saltglass Working
research.about: Driftkey saltglass: a clear, hard blade and the panes for a Greenhouse.

research.name: Bogsteel Smelting
research.about: Mirefen bog iron makes the first tools that bite into sunsteel and blight ore.

research.name: Sunsteel Tempering
research.about: Golden Sunscour steel: a blade, a full suit of armor, and the Waypad that links your outposts.

research.name: Blightsteel Quenching
research.about: Dark Blightmoor steel quenched in its own pools: the best pick and axe, a fang of a sword, and thorned armor.

research.name: Starsteel Casting
research.about: Glowdeep starcrystal cast into steel: the finest edge and armor there is.
