quests.name: The Sealed Storm
quests.about: Why the storm stands round Rimewild, and the road to the eight Wardens who hold its locks.

quests.title: Washed Ashore
quests.story: The storm that stands round Rimewild broke your boat and threw you onto a ledge above the Dawnfield. Everything you owned is at the bottom of the sea. Start with what the ground gives you.
quests.how: Walk up to sticks, stones and fiber bundles and tap PICK UP. Then MENU > CRAFT and make a Stone Hatchet and a Stone Pick.

quests.title: Something to Throw
quests.story: Your partner found you before you found it, and has not left your heel since. The islanders have a word for that - kin - and a way of asking for it: a Tether Seed, which takes root in a tired creature's trust.
quests.how: Fiber comes from bushes and fiberleaf (your hatchet shakes bark fiber out of trees too). MENU > CRAFT > Tether Seed.

quests.title: A Second Friend
quests.story: One kin is company. Two is the start of a camp.
quests.how: Fight a wild kin until its health is low, tap SEED so the seed is in your hand, then THROW. The lower its health, the surer the catch - the ring shows the odds.

quests.title: Side by Side
quests.story: Not everything on the Dawnfield wants to be friends. Learn to fight as a pair before you leave it.
quests.how: KIN calls your companion out. LOCK holds one target, and the four chips above the action buttons order its skills. Hold ATTACK to keep swinging.

quests.title: A Fire of Your Own
quests.story: The wind off the sea has teeth after dark. You need a fire with walls round it, and somewhere to put what you carry.
quests.how: Tap BUILD and place a Hearthstone on flat ground. Everything inside its ring is your camp: kin work there, and you wake there if you fall.

quests.title: The Dawnfield Path
quests.story: A worn path runs north from the Dawnfield gate, hung with lanterns somebody keeps lit. There is smoke at the far end of it.
quests.how: Follow the pale trail with the lantern posts. The gold marker on your minimap points the way.

quests.title: The Standing Stone
quests.story: Hearthmere's Kinkeeper, Juno, looks you over. "Off a wreck? Then you have met the storm. It has stood round this island since Stormcrest shut itself in its Aerie, and no boat leaves until it lifts. Start small. Wake a waystone - the island answers those who do."
quests.how: Waystones are tall glowing stones. Walk up to one and tap ATTUNE. Awake stones are fast-travel points on the Map.

quests.title: Eight Locks
quests.story: "Eight Wardens hold eight Sigils," Juno says. "They are the locks on the Aerie door, set there by the first keepers so that nobody would wake the storm-bird lightly. Each one tests whoever comes asking. The nearest sleeps in Bloomwyrm Grove, west of here. Do not go as you are."
quests.how: Kin gain levels by fighting beside you (the active one most, the rest of the party half). Catching new kinds is the fastest way to fill a party.

quests.title: The Bloomwyrm
quests.story: The grove is too quiet and the flowers are too large. Somewhere under the petals something very old is pretending to be asleep.
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 150 Glimmer, 3x Ironbark Seed, 3x Kin Treat, 75 XP

quests.title: Across the Water
quests.story: The first Sigil hums in your pack like a struck bell. Juno turns it over twice. "That is one. The next is over open sea, on the Driftkey Isles to the south-west. Nothing on two feet crosses that - but a water kin will carry you, and gladly."
quests.how: Any Tide kin (or one that lives by water) will surf: summon it, wade in and tap SURF. No harness needed. The lagoon between the Driftkeys is shallow enough to wade.
todo: Own a kin that can surf
Set foot on the Driftkey Isles

quests.title: The Coral Throne
quests.story: The islanders say the reef grew a guardian the way a shell grows a pearl: slowly, around something that hurt.
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 200 Glimmer, 4x Ironbark Seed, 3x Healing Salve, 100 XP

quests.title: Fire Country
quests.story: East of the Sunmeadow the grass gives out and the ground starts to smoke. The people of Cinderhold live there on purpose, which tells you most of what you need to know about them.
quests.how: The road east from Hearthmere runs all the way to Cinderhold. Watch for geysers on the Ashfall Flats: the ground rumbles before one blows.

quests.title: Solarion's Caldera
quests.story: Kinkeeper Brask points with his chin. "Up in the caldera. It does not like visitors and it does not like shade. Bring something wet."
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 280 Glimmer, 5x Ironbark Seed, 3x Kin Treat, 140 XP

quests.title: The Drowned Heart
quests.story: The third Sigil lies east across the water in Mirefen, where the trees stand on their own roots and the lights between them are not lanterns.
quests.how: Surf east from the Badlands coast. In the fen, spore pods swell before they burst - step back and the poison cloud misses you.

quests.title: Three Heads
quests.story: Something in the Sunken Heart has been counting your footsteps since the shore. It has three heads to count with.
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 300 Glimmer, 2x Starbloom Seed, 4x Healing Salve, 150 XP

quests.title: The Glacier's Light
quests.story: Back on the old island the road climbs north-west into the Rimefang Peaks. Frostgate sits where the pines stop, with every door facing away from the wind.
quests.how: Snow and blizzards chill you: cook warm food, wear furs, or keep a warm kin out. The road from Hearthmere reaches Frostgate.

quests.title: Aurora Glacier
quests.story: Kinkeeper Sella does not look up from her fire. "You will know the place. The sky comes down to look at it."
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 380 Glimmer, 3x Starbloom Seed, 4x Kin Treat, 190 XP

quests.title: The Laughing Wind
quests.story: North-east over the sea the Sunscour Dunes lie under a sun that takes it personally. The wind there has a voice, and the voice has a temple.
quests.how: The dunes bake you by day: travel at night or carry cooling food. Quicksand drags at your feet - keep moving and save your stamina.
todo: Set foot on the Sunscour Dunes

quests.title: The Sun Temple
quests.story: It has been laughing at travellers for a thousand years. It would like very much to be given a reason to stop.
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 420 Glimmer, 3x Starbloom Seed, 4x Healing Salve, 210 XP

quests.title: What the Crater Keeps
quests.story: North, past where the charts stop, the Blightmoor rots quietly round a hole in the world. The first keepers put a Warden there for a reason they did not write down.
quests.how: Its pools are poison to wade - ride a kin through them. A Sporecap Draught blocks Poison outright. Wild kin there are a little stronger after dark.

quests.title: The Blight Crater
quests.story: Something heavy uncoils when you come to the rim. It has been patient for longer than the villages have had names.
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 520 Glimmer, 4x Starbloom Seed, 5x Healing Salve, 260 XP

quests.title: Every Light Looks Back
quests.story: The last Sigil is far to the west, in Glowdeep, where night never quite ends and the ground gives off its own stars.
quests.how: Glowdeep's kin are the strongest on the map. Shimmer kin turn up twice as often there at night.

quests.title: Star Hollow
quests.story: Every light in the hollow turns to look at you. Then the largest one blinks.
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 600 Glimmer, 5x Starbloom Seed, 5x Kin Treat, 300 XP

quests.title: The Eighth Lock
quests.story: Eight Sigils, and each one is singing a different note. Juno listens for a long time. "It can hear them too, you know. It has been listening to you come this whole way."
quests.how: Any Warden you passed over still holds its Sigil - the JOURNEY tab lists them all.

quests.title: The Sealed Storm
quests.story: The Aerie door stands open at the heart of the island. Above it the sky is perfectly clear, and thunder answers from it anyway. Go and ask the storm-bird to let the sea go.
quests.how: Stand at the shrine inside the ring of standing stones, tap WARDEN, then CHALLENGE. It fights you and your companion together. Leave the ring or faint and it goes back to sleep - nothing is lost, so a failed try costs you nothing.
quests.reward: 1000 Glimmer, 6x Starbloom Seed, 6x Kin Treat, 500 XP

quests.name: Hearth and Home
quests.about: Your camp, from one fire and one worker to a home that runs itself.

quests.title: Hands for the Work
quests.story: A fire keeps you warm. A camp keeps you fed while you are somewhere else.
quests.how: BUILD > Production: a Lumber Mill, Stone Quarry, Crop Plot or Forage Hut. Then MENU > KIN, pick a kin and send it TO CAMP - it takes the job it is best at.
todo: Send a kin to work at camp

quests.title: A Place to Make Things
quests.story: Your knees are tired of being a table.
quests.how: BUILD > Crafting > Workbench, and BUILD > Storage > Storage Chest. Anything in camp storage counts as yours when you craft inside the ring.

quests.title: Supper
quests.story: Kin work on a full stomach or not at all, and so do you.
quests.how: A Campfire cooks: walk up and tap COOK. A Feed Box holds food for your workers, so they stop coming to find you when they are hungry.

quests.title: A Proper Crew
quests.story: One pair of hands is a favour. Three is a camp.
quests.how: The Hearthstone itself can be upgraded: MENU > CAMP > Overview > UPGRADE. Each level lets more kin work and adds storage. A Kin Nest gives them somewhere to sleep.

quests.title: Fire and Stone
quests.story: Stone tools only go so far, and you have found where.
quests.how: A Smelter turns ore and cinder into ingots; it needs a kin that can Kindle (Ember kin, and most Volt and Lumen ones). Ore comes from the darker, speckled rocks.

quests.title: Better Edges
quests.story: An ingot axe goes through a tree in half the swings, and an ingot pick opens rocks a stone one only scratches.
quests.how: Workbench > Tools. Harder rocks, and the prism veins high in the Peaks, need the Ingot Pick.

quests.title: Rod and Line
quests.story: The water round here is full of supper that nobody is using.
quests.how: Craft a Fishing Rod by hand. Fishing spots are rings on the water near a bank: tap FISH, wait, then REEL when it bites. Fish feed your workers too.

quests.title: Room to Grow
quests.story: The ring of firelight is getting crowded.
quests.how: CAMP > Overview shows what the next Hearthstone level costs. Camp > Workers shows who is doing what, and Camp > Structures where more hands would help.

quests.title: Bright Ideas
quests.story: You keep having ideas for things you do not know how to build yet.
quests.how: A Research Bench studies blueprints: pay the materials, then a Crafting kin (or you, with WORK) puts in the hours. Many blueprints need a land's Sigil first.

quests.title: A Hotter Fire
quests.story: The metals of the outer lands laugh at your Smelter.
quests.how: Research Alloy Forging, then build the Alloy Forge. Every outer-land metal starts there.

quests.title: Far Hands
quests.story: There is ore on the far shores, and nobody there to dig it.
quests.how: Research Outpost Logistics (it needs the Driftkey Sigil), craft an Outpost Kit and USE it on an outer land. Station two kin there and a caravan brings what they gather home.

quests.title: Metals of the Outer Lands
quests.story: Saltglass, bogsteel, sunsteel, blightsteel, starsteel: five lands, five metals, and each one opens tools and armour the last could not.
quests.how: Each metal's research needs its land's Sigil and some of its ore. Research > Metals.

quests.title: The Hearth Grows
quests.story: Travellers have started asking whether this is a village.
quests.how: Hearthstone levels 4 to 6 cost outer-land bars and Warden Hearts. Each adds storage and room for more workers.

quests.title: Sparks
quests.story: Some of your kin crackle when they are bored. Put that to use.
quests.how: A Volt Pylon run by a Charging kin powers the camp: sprinklers, turrets and the machines that come after.

quests.title: It Runs Itself
quests.story: The best camp is the one that does not notice you are gone.
quests.how: A Conveyor Hub moves goods to storage without haulers. An Auto-Assembler works a queue of orders by itself while the camp is powered.

quests.title: A Home Worth the Storm
quests.story: One fire, once. Look at it now.
quests.how: The last Hearthstone level wants the rarest bars and a good many Warden Hearts.

quests.name: Bonds
quests.about: Raising, bonding with and understanding the kin who travel with you.

quests.title: Call the Shot
quests.story: Your kin will fight without being asked. It fights much better when it is.
quests.how: With a wild kin in front of you (or locked), tap one of the four skill chips above the action buttons. Your companion runs in and uses that skill.
todo: Order a skill from the skill bar

quests.title: Strength in Numbers
quests.story: Different kin are good at different things, and the island has a lot of different things.
quests.how: Up to five kin travel in your party; the KIN bar swaps which one is out. The rest wait in the Hearth Box at camp.

quests.title: A Second Trick
quests.story: Kin learn a new skill at levels 5, 10 and 15.
quests.how: The kin that is out earns full experience and the rest of the party half. MENU > KIN shows what each one will learn next.

quests.title: Trust
quests.story: A kin that trusts you hits harder, guards better and, in the end, refuses to fall.
quests.how: Bond grows from fighting together, from PET when the prompt shows, and from FEED in the Kin tab. Each bond level adds 3% to its attack and defence.
todo: Reach bond level 1 with a kin

quests.title: Know Your Elements
quests.story: Water puts out fire, fire eats leaves, leaves drink water - and seven more besides. The right kin makes a hard fight a short one.
quests.how: A hit that says "Super effective" did half again as much. The Dex shows each kin's elements; a target's are on its frame.

quests.title: A Friendly Match
quests.story: Other people keep kin too, and some of them stand by the road looking for someone to prove it to.
quests.how: Rival tamers wait along the roads out of each village (crossed swords on the map). Tap CHALLENGE: their kin come out one at a time and cannot be caught.

quests.title: Coming Along
quests.story: Ten kinds caught, and you are starting to tell the tracks apart.
quests.how: A kin's third skill comes at Lv 10. New kinds are worth double experience the first time you catch them.

quests.title: One of a Kind
quests.story: A few kin know a trick nobody else does: a step through shadow, a shield planted in front of you, a song that speeds the whole camp.
quests.how: Look for the characters: Kagekit and Hexpurr in the Sunmeadow, Bulwarden in the meadow and Peaks, Lilute by ponds, Cindra where the grass meets the Badlands. The Kin tab explains each signature skill.
todo: Own a kin with a signature skill

quests.title: The Big One
quests.story: Every land has a few kin that grew too big and too bold. They keep lairs, and they keep trophies.
quests.how: Alphas are larger, glow at the edges and hit hard. The first of each kind you beat always drops a trophy accessory.

quests.title: Ascension
quests.story: At twenty levels something in a kin changes. It stands taller. It starts to shine.
quests.how: MENU > KIN, pick a kin of Lv 20 or more and tap EVOLVE: +15% to every stat, a little more work at camp, and a new look.

quests.title: New Life
quests.story: Two kin, a warm nest and ten minutes of patience.
quests.how: Build a Hatchery and pair two kin there. The egg hatches into one of their kinds with the better parent's quality. Wild nests sometimes hold an egg too, if you can get past the mother.

quests.title: Close as Kin
quests.story: It has started finishing your sentences, which is impressive for something that cannot talk.
quests.how: At bond level 3 a companion's skills recharge 10% faster.
todo: Reach bond level 3 with a kin (3)

quests.title: Known on the Road
quests.story: Word gets round. The tamers have started practising before you arrive.
quests.how: Each village has a Tamer and an Ace on its roads. Wins also raise your standing with the village.

quests.title: Field Notes
quests.story: Twenty-five kinds in the book. The Kinkeepers have started asking you questions.
quests.how: The Dex shows where each kin lives and when. Catching one of a kind makes every later catch of it 10% easier.

quests.title: A Different Coat
quests.story: Once in a long while a kin is born the wrong colour, and it is the best thing that ever happened to it.
quests.how: Shimmer kin sparkle and work one level better at every camp job. They are rare everywhere, less rare on shimmer nights and in Glowdeep after dark.

quests.title: Exalted
quests.story: There is a second change, later, for kin that have come a long way with somebody.
quests.how: MENU > KIN, the same EVOLVE button again at Lv 35.

quests.title: Unbreakable
quests.story: There is a point past which a kin simply will not leave you, whatever is standing over it.
quests.how: At bond level 5 a companion survives a blow that would have dropped it, once every ten minutes.
todo: Reach bond level 5 with a kin (5)

quests.title: Keeper of Kin
quests.story: Sixty kinds, and one of yours could stand in a Warden's ring by itself.
quests.how: The Dex milestones pay out along the way - MILESTONES in the Dex tab.

quests.name: Explorer Stars
quests.about: Stars for doing fun things, in any order you like.

quests.title: Best Friends
quests.story: Your kin loves a scratch behind the ears.
quests.how: Stand next to your kin and tap PET.

quests.title: A New Friend
quests.story: There are kin everywhere. Any of them could come with you.
quests.how: Walk up to a wild kin and tap SEED.

quests.title: The Village
quests.story: Somebody lives at the end of the lantern path.
quests.how: Follow the arrow, or follow your kin - it knows the way.

quests.title: The Glowing Stone
quests.story: Tall stones hum when you come close.
quests.how: Follow the arrow to a tall stone and tap ATTUNE.

quests.title: Splash!
quests.story: The water is lovely.
quests.how: Walk into the sea or a pond. You can't sink.

quests.title: Giddy Up
quests.story: Your kin would love to carry you.
quests.how: With a bigger kin out, tap RIDE.

quests.title: Five Friends
quests.story: A whole parade of them.
quests.how: Catch more kin. Up to five walk with you.

quests.title: Brave
quests.story: Some kin like a scrap. So do yours.
quests.how: Tap ATTACK near a wild kin. Your kin helps.

quests.title: My Camp
quests.story: A place that is yours.
quests.how: Tap BUILD and put down a Hearthstone. HOME brings you back to it.

quests.title: Builder
quests.story: A camp needs things in it.
quests.how: Tap BUILD and put down anything you like. It is all free.

quests.title: Sticker Collector
quests.story: Ten different kinds!
quests.how: Every new kind you catch is a sticker in your book.

quests.title: Top of the World
quests.story: You can see everything from up there.
quests.how: Find a lookout tower and tap LOOK OUT.

quests.title: Treasure!
quests.story: Old camps and wrecks have chests in them.
quests.how: Find a chest and tap OPEN.

quests.title: Into the Dark
quests.story: There are holes in the hills.
quests.how: Walk around until you find a cave mouth.

quests.title: Champion
quests.story: Somebody by the road wants a match.
quests.how: Find a tamer near the village and tap CHALLENGE.

quests.title: Across the Sea
quests.story: There is more land out there.
quests.how: Ride a water kin out over the sea.

quests.title: Sparkles
quests.story: Some kin are a different colour, and they glitter.
quests.how: Keep catching kin. The sparkly ones are special.

quests.title: The Big Boss
quests.story: Something huge sleeps in the grove.
quests.how: Follow the arrow to the ring of stones and tap WARDEN.

quests.title: Super Collector
quests.story: Twenty-five different kinds!
quests.how: Look in new places for new kin.

quests.name: The Other Partners
quests.about: The two partners you did not choose are waiting with the Kinkeepers of Cinderhold and Frostgate.

quests.title: Knuckub of Cinderhold
quests.story: Kinkeeper Brask keeps a young Knuckub behind his stall that has chewed through three leads. "Walked in off the Dawnfield road looking for somebody," he says. "Not me, evidently. Show me you can hold your own on these roads, and that the village will vouch for you, and we will see whether it was you."
quests.how: Tamers stand along the roads out of the village (crossed swords on the map): tap CHALLENGE. The notice board by the gate has requests, and finishing them raises your standing. Then walk back into Cinderhold.
todo: Beat a tamer on Cinderhold's roads
Become a Visitor in Cinderhold (finish requests on its board)
Go back to Kinkeeper Brask in Cinderhold
quests.reward: Knuckub joins you, 200 Glimmer, 4x Kin Treat, 150 XP

quests.title: Knuckub of Frostgate
quests.story: A Knuckub has slept by Kinkeeper Sella's fire all winter with one eye on the gate. "It is waiting for someone," she says. "I will not hand it to a stranger my neighbours have never heard of, or to anybody whose own kin do not trust them."
quests.how: Tamers stand along the roads out of the village: tap CHALLENGE. Requests on the board by the gate raise your standing. Bond grows from fighting beside a kin, PET and FEED. Then walk back into Frostgate.
todo: Beat a tamer on Frostgate's roads
Become a Visitor in Frostgate (finish requests on its board)
Reach bond level 2 with one of your kin (2)
Go back to Kinkeeper Sella in Frostgate
quests.reward: Knuckub joins you, 350 Glimmer, 6x Kin Treat, 250 XP

regions.name: Dawnfield
regions.about: The quiet fields where every explorer starts.

regions.name: Petalrun
regions.about: Hills thick with blossom. Flora and Lumen kin gather here.

regions.name: Oldgrowth Weald
regions.about: Old, dark woodland. Good logging, and Flora kin in every shadow.

regions.name: Honeydew Downs
regions.about: Open golden grass under a wide sky. Gale and Normal kin roam it.

regions.name: Ashfall Flats
regions.about: Grey ash and steam vents. Ember and Shade kin.

regions.name: Redrock Canyons
regions.about: Deep red stone, rich in ore. Stone kin.

regions.name: Glasswaste
regions.about: Black glass left by an old fire. Shade kin, and crystal.

regions.name: Frostpine Hollow
regions.about: A sheltered pinewood below the snow. Frost and Flora kin.

regions.name: Shiverglass Field
regions.about: A sheet of blue ice - mind where it has gone thin. Frost and Tide kin.

regions.name: Stormspine Ridge
regions.about: Bare dark rock that draws the lightning. Volt and Gale kin.

regions.name: Coral Shallows
regions.about: Pink coral sand and warm pools. Tide and Lumen kin.

regions.name: Palmreach
regions.about: The green heart of the isles. Flora and Gale kin.

regions.name: Shellstrand
regions.about: White sand heaped with shells. Stone and Tide kin.

regions.name: Lanternfen
regions.about: Lights drift over this water after dark. Lumen kin.

regions.name: Blackroot Tangle
regions.about: Mangroves so thick the day stays dim. Shade and Flora kin.

regions.name: Lilymere
regions.about: Bright shallows carpeted in lilies. Tide and Flora kin.

regions.name: Glass Dunes
regions.about: Pale dunes that sing in the wind. Lumen and Gale kin.

regions.name: Redstone Reach
regions.about: Red rock shelves and hidden ore. Stone and Ember kin.

regions.name: Verdant Oasis
regions.about: Green ground in the middle of the sand. Flora and Normal kin.

regions.name: Sporefall
regions.about: Fungus as far as you can see, and the air is thick with it. Flora and Shade kin.

regions.name: The Seep
regions.about: Black tar wells up through the ground. Shade and Tide kin.

regions.name: Withered Briar
regions.about: A dead thorn-wood. Shade and Stone kin.

regions.name: Starmoss Fields
regions.about: Moss that shines like a night sky underfoot. Lumen and Flora kin.

regions.name: Crystal Reach
regions.about: Violet crystal breaks through the ground. Stone and Frost kin.

regions.name: Mooncap Grove
regions.about: Pale giant mushrooms close overhead. Shade and Lumen kin.

hunts.intro: Fisherfolk on the Driftkeys swear the lagoon glows some nights. Something big is making that light. Start where you make landfall and look for shells that shine.
The Mirefen's trees stand in rows where nobody planted them. Something walks through that fen and leaves a forest behind it. Find where it walked.
Travellers in the Sunscour keep finding glass in the sand. Still hot. In the shape of wings. I want to know what lands there.
Something on the Blightmoor is making new pools faster than the old ones dry. I want to know what sleeps there. Bring a good mount and better medicine.
Every night the Glowdeep's mushrooms light up in a line, as if something ran past them. Nothing I own is fast enough to see what. Maybe you are.
